name: TestFlight beta distribution
userOutcome: An authorized beta tester can install the processed AuraFit build from TestFlight, complete the core loop, exercise sandbox purchases, and submit useful feedback.
productionDataSource: The signed Release archive, App Store Connect app and StoreKit records, TestFlight processing/review state, and repository evidence under quality/evidence/testflight.
errorBehavior: A failed gate remains blocked or verification_pending with exact evidence. No task is marked done by substituting simulator/local StoreKit evidence for signing, physical-device, sandbox, upload, or TestFlight behavior.
accessibilityRequirements: Core beta path is operable with VoiceOver
Core screens remain usable at accessibility text sizes
Permission and purchase recovery instructions are announced and actionable
prohibitedBehavior: Do not upload an archive built from a commit that has not passed the release gate
Do not reuse an App Store Connect build number
Do not commit Apple credentials, signing material, receipts, or tester personal data
Do not treat Jira or Notion as authoritative over repository task definitions
Do not invite external testers before required beta information and review gates are complete
acceptanceTests: All TF-G1 checklist items have task-scoped evidence
An internal tester installs the processed build from TestFlight and passes the release smoke
Production StoreKit products display and pass purchase restore expiry revoke and offline tests
Public privacy and support URLs work signed out and metadata matches the binary
For external distribution the build passes TestFlight App Review and an external tester installs it
Beta feedback is triaged and an explicit go or no-go decision is recorded
